### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A20, A21, A30, A31, and A32 each occurred in every trace (100% participation); in the later window they occur in at most 1% of traces (A30 and A31 at 1%, A32 at 0.5%, A20 and A21 at 0%). [OCC006, OCC007, OCC012, OCC013, OCC014]
- Activity A04 occurred in 76% of traces earlier and in 19.5% later, with mean occurrences per trace dropping from 0.815 to 0.21. [OCC001]
- New activities appear in the later window: A22 in 23.5% of traces, A23 in 21.5%, A24 in 23%, A19 in 18.5%, and A25 in 16% (all absent or nearly absent earlier). [OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, OCC005, OCC011]
- The outgoing edges of A20 and A21 disappear entirely (no successors observed later), while A30, A31, and A32 now lead to different activities (e.g., A30 to A28/A39, A31 to A12/A23, A32 to A26) instead of the earlier set. [DIR006, DIR007, DIR011, DIR012, DIR013]
- A14 and A15 remain in all traces, but their successors changed: A14 went to A15 in 97.5% of cases earlier and 84.6% later, with new edges to A08, A06, A04, A10; A15 went to A16 in 98.3% earlier and 91% later, with new edges to A08, A06, A04, A10. [DIR003, DIR004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a change in the control flow: the process moved from a structure that always executed a set of activities (A20, A21, A30, A31, A32) and often A04, to a structure that instead executes a new set of activities (A22, A23, A24, A19, A25) and rarely A04. This is directly shown by the near-total disappearance of the old activities, the appearance of the new ones, and the complete change in outgoing edges of the old activities. The change is consistent across participation, occurrence, and successor indicators. A competing explanation that the later window simply contains a different case type cannot be ruled out, but the evidence clearly indicates a structural change in the process.

Other differences: The successors of A14 and A15 also changed, with new edges to A08, A06, A04, and A10, indicating a rerouting after these activities. [DIR003, DIR004] The position of A33 shifted earlier (mean position from 0.47 to 0.40) [POS013], but this is secondary.
